item.name: Look up a property by Zillow URL

request.name: Look up a property by Zillow URL

description.content: Fetch the full property record for a Zillow URL (homedetails, /b/, /community/, or /apartments/). When `extract_units` is not `disabled` and the URL is a multi-unit building, `data` is returned as an array of unit records. Costs 1 credit per record returned; failed calls are free.

query.description: For building URLs, which units to extract. `disabled` returns the parent record only; any other value returns an array of unit records.

response.name: Single property (an array of Property when extract_units is set and the URL is a multi-unit building)

item.name: Look up a property by address

request.name: Look up a property by address

description.content: Resolve a full street address (street, city, state, ZIP) to a property record via upstream geocoding. Costs 3 credits per successful call because the address is resolved upstream; failed calls are free.

query.description: (Required) Full street address including city, state, and ZIP; geocoded upstream.

info.name: Zillapi: Zillow property data Properties API

description.content:
Real estate data API. Look up properties by URL, address, or zpid; search listings; extract multi-unit buildings; run async batches; receive results via signed webhooks.
